snippet.title: Get Up and Dance (PS3) Trailer
snippet.description: Movemodo - Get Up and Dance is the latest game to challenge for the PS3 dancing crown, currently held by... well... nothing, really. Can O-Games pull it off? We'll see on 4th November!
